moral.zh: 泡泡薄膜两面反射的光会发生薄膜干涉，不同厚度让不同颜色增强或减弱。
moral.en: Light reflected from the two sides of a soap film can interfere, making different colors stronger or weaker.

pages.zhText: 阳台上，米米吹出一串泡泡。咦，肥皂泡为什么有彩色？
pages.enText: On the balcony, Mimi blows a stream of bubbles. “Why do soap bubbles have colors?”

pages.zhText: 爸爸说：“泡泡外面和里面，夹着一层很薄的肥皂水膜。”
pages.enText: Dad explains, “A bubble is a very thin film of soapy water, with air on both sides.”

pages.enText: When sunlight arrives, some reflects from the outer surface, and some travels through the film and reflects from the inner surface.

pages.zhText: 两束反射光叠在一起：有的颜色变强，有的变弱，这叫薄膜干涉。
pages.enText: The two reflected light waves overlap: some colors become stronger, while others become weaker. This is called thin-film interference.

pages.zhText: 水膜慢慢向下流，越来越薄；颜色流动变化，破前局部还会发暗。
pages.enText: The soapy film slowly drains downward and gets thinner. Its colors shift and flow, and parts may grow dark just before it pops.
